verdict.rationale: WezTerm's automation lives in a plain Lua config file. A user reports it is "just Lua code, easy to diff and easy to apply" when synced with chezmoi, and WezTerm watches and auto-reloads the file on change. So versioning, review and rollback are possible, but only through external tools like git or chezmoi rather than anything built in. Missing for 10: native versioning or history of automations, built-in review/diff or rollback, and first-party docs on managing config revisions.
